scientific_limitations: Results concern annealed infinite-line zero-temperature Glauber/voter dynamics with a shared Pareto clock and iid initial spins; no finite-temperature, quenched, finite-ring-uniform, or thermodynamic field-response conclusion. The infinite-mean renewal regime has only a finite-dimensional long-time limit. A broader unpublished or unlocated renewal/coalescence theorem may imply parts of the result.
title: Algebraic spatial correlations and a sharp susceptibility threshold in a globally reset kinetic Ising chain
